mechanics.claim: The attack speed and movement speed bonuses ramp up from their base value to double that value over the first 5 seconds of the buff.
mechanics.quote: with both of the bonuses increasing in effectiveness by {{pp|key=%|type=seconds elapsed|0 to 100 for 21|0 to 5}}

mechanics.claim: Bailout's duration resets whenever the target scores a takedown within 6 seconds of damaging the enemy.
mechanics.quote: ''Bailout's'' duration resets whenever the target scores a {{tip|takedown}} against an enemy champion within 6 seconds of damaging them.

mechanics.claim: If the buff is refreshed, the attack/move speed ramp effectiveness does not reset.
mechanics.quote: ''Bailout's'' bonuses will not reset in effectiveness if its duration is refreshed.

mechanics.claim: The lethal-damage restore-and-burn effect can trigger only once per application of Bailout while the target is not already burning.
mechanics.quote: This effect may occur only ''once'' per application of ''Bailout'' while the target already has the buff and is not burning.

mechanics.claim: The self-damage burn is raw damage calculated from the target's maximum health at the moment lethal damage was taken.
mechanics.quote: The self-damage taken is considered {{tip|raw damage}} and is calculated based on the target's '''maximum''' health at the time of taking lethal damage.

mechanics.claim: Casting Bailout on a target that already has the buff only refreshes its duration without resetting the AS/MS ramp.
mechanics.quote: Casting ''Bailout'' on a target that already has the buff will only refresh the duration (without resetting the bonuses).
